deployments_detail.use: WPS AI office assistant with document writing PPT generation and table analysis

WPS AI office assistant (core LLM productivity in Writer/Sheets/Presentation/PDF): AI writing (drafting, rewriting, summarizing, polishing), AI reading, AI data assistant, AI design/PPT generation. Launched to public beta Nov 2023, backbone of the product suite. [MiniMax, Zhipu AI, Baidu Wenxin/ERNIE (multi-model backend)]

WPS AI multi-LLM backend: WPS AI routes tasks across domestic Chinese LLMs. Company disclosed on the SSE interactive platform that WPS AI primarily connects to Wenxin/ERNIE, MiniMax, and Zhipu AI, all filed under China's generative AI regulations. [Baidu Wenxin/ERNIE, MiniMax, Zhipu AI]

WPS AI overseas edition built on Amazon Bedrock with Anthropic Claude 3 as the foundation model, powering spell check, content rewriting, PPT/slide generation, data analysis and knowledge extraction (200k-token context) for global WPS Office users. In production. [AWS (Amazon Bedrock), Anthropic Claude 3]
deployments_detail.value: 35% reduction in operational costs; 30% increase in R&D efficiency; deployment cut from 3 months to 2; serves 200M+ overseas users

deployments_detail.use: WPS AI Government Edition (政务版): government office model 1.0 covering government AI writing, AI Q&A and AI tools; built on a self-developed 13B model with hundred-million-scale government pre-training corpus for official-document (公文) generation. [Kingsoft self-developed 13B model]

WPS 365 integration of DeepSeek: parts of the WPS 365 platform (cloud-document intelligent Q&A, 'AI Ask') call DeepSeek models for stronger reasoning, alongside Zhipu, MiniMax and Wenxin. [DeepSeek (also Zhipu AI, MiniMax, Wenxin)]

WPS Lingxi (WPS 灵犀 / WPS AI 3.0): native Office AI agent letting users complete document creation, PPT generation and voice-assistant tasks via natural-language multi-turn dialogue without external app-switching. Awarded WAIC 2025 'treasure of the exhibition'. [Kingsoft (native agent; DeepSeek R1 among integrated models)]

WPS Comate AI office client for organizations (ToB) and Lingxi Professional Edition for individuals (ToC): task-executing AI agents that finish work rather than just answer questions; launched at the 2026 WPS AI Productivity Launch Event. [Kingsoft Office]
WPS AI spreadsheet agent: autonomous agent that operates spreadsheets; topped the global SpreadsheetBench benchmark. [Kingsoft Office]

WPS AI 'AI companion writing' (AI伴写): immersive, human-led continuation writing that predicts intended content in ~0.5s, references local/cloud docs and web pages, and uses a self-built 'golden-phrase' knowledge base (classical poetry, laws, templates) plus a self-developed small model to reduce hallucination; offers role-based personas (general, administrative, teacher, operations). [Kingsoft self-developed small model + golden-phrase knowledge base]

WPS AI Enterprise Edition (WPS AI 企业版): AI Hub multi-model base, AI Docs turns enterprise documents into an intelligent document library with Q&A and creation; when integrated into enterprise business systems it assists after-sales and customer-service departments. [AI Hub (MiniMax, Zhipu AI, Wenxin, SenseTime, Tongyi Qianwen)]
